blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Public hubs offer many personalized LoRAs per text-to-image backbone, yet composing two of them in one image remains fragile. In FLUX, keeping a pool of $K=10$ or $20$ subject LoRAs loaded makes their deltas interfere, and even loading only the two requested LoRAs keeps both subjects in fewer than 4% of images: one subject vanishes, the two fuse, or the image splits into a collage. We present MORE (Merge Once, Route Early), a training-free two-stage pipeline for FLUX. Merge once: the whole pool is folded into a single fixed-rank adapter by the subspace-regression router of SSR-Merge, made reliable by ridge, rank and calibration choices, and factored exactly into a shared part and per-subject parts. Route early: during the first 30% of the denoising steps each subject's part is gated to its layout region; a decaying soft attention bias ties every region to its own subject tokens, and a cyclic swap guidance extrapolates away from the prediction with the subjects' regions permuted, which counteracts region homogenization. On held-out seeds, MORE keeps both subjects in 94.2% ($K=10$) and 78.3% ($K=20$) of images, against 50.8% / 35.8% for FreeFuse and 25.0% / 24.2% for LoRAShop, and reaches an ImageReward of 1.32 (best baseline 0.07), while all $K$ subjects stay in one adapter. With layouts inferred automatically it still keeps both subjects in 70.0% / 55.0% of images.
blocks.zh: 公共枢纽提供许多个性化的LORAs,每个文本到图像主干线,然而将其中两个组成一个图像仍然脆弱. 在FLUX中,保留一个$K=10美元或$20的主体LORAs加载使得他们的三角洲干扰,即使加载只有两个被请求的LORAs将两个主体保存在不到4%的图像中:一个主体消失,两个导火线,或者图像被分解为拼接. 我们提出更多(Morge Once, Route Early),这是FLUX的无培训两阶段管道. 合并一次:整个池由SSR-Merge的子空间后退路由器折叠成一个单一的固定等级的适配器,由脊,分级和校正选择而变得可靠,并精确地计入一个共享部分和每个主体部分. 路由早期:在前30%的去Noiding步骤中,每个主体的部分被门接通到其布局区域;衰弱的软注意力偏好将每个区域与自己的主题符号联系起来,循环互换指导从与被主体所在区域的预测中推导出,这与区域同质化相悖. 在被搁置的种子上,更多的标本在94.2%(K=10美元)和78.3%(K=20美元)的图像中保留,而FreeFuse为50.8%/35.8%,LORASHP为25.0%/24.2%,并达到1.32(最佳基准0.07)的图像奖励,而所有美元标本都留在一个适配器中。 随着布局的自动推断,它仍然将两个主体保留在70.0%/55.0%的图像中.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) [ 16 ] has turned personalization into a commodity: a few images of a pet, a toy or a pair of sneakers yield a small adapter that renders that subject in new scenes [ 36 ] . A user who owns a pool of such adapters naturally asks for several of them at once, “a sks cat and a sks robot toy in a grassy field”. On large diffusion transformers such as FLUX [ 3 ] , this request fails in two coupled ways. Pool crosstalk: serving any subset of K K subjects without reloading means keeping all K K deltas active, and since community LoRAs share trigger words and are never trained to stay silent on other subjects, the K − 1 K{-}1 foreign deltas add up: on a subject’s own prompt tokens they produce a median 8 × 8\times ( K = 10 K{=}10 ) and 17 × 17\times ( K = 20 K{=}20 ) the output energy of the subject’s own LoRA. Coexistence collapse: even when exactly the two requested LoRAs are loaded, a token-agnostic adapter applies both identities everywhere, and FLUX’s joint attention lets every image token read both subjects’ text tokens. One subject disappears, the two fuse into a hybrid, or the model escapes into a split-screen collage. Naively loading the two LoRAs keeps both subjects in 1.7 % 1.7\% of our held-out images, below the 26.7 % 26.7\% of the base model that knows only the class words ( Tab. 1 ); stress tests of multi-subject personalization report the same collapse [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 低档改编(LORA)[16]将个性化转化为商品: 几幅宠物,玩具或一对运动鞋的图像产生一个小适配器,使得该主题在新场景中成为了[36]. 拥有一批此类适配器的用户自然会同时要求若干个适配器,即“在草场中一只滑冰猫和一个滑冰机器人玩具”。 在诸如FLUX[3]等大型扩散变压器上,这项请求以两种方式失效。 Pool crossalk:在不重装的情况下服务K主题的任何子集,意味着保持所有K K deltas的活性,由于社区 LoRAs共享触发词,并且从未接受过在其他主题上保持沉默的训练,K−1 K{}1 外国三角塔加起来:在一个主题本身的即时信号上,它们产生一个中位数8×8\时(K=10K{=}10)和17×17\时(K=20K{=}20)这个主题自己 LoRA的输出能量. 共存崩溃:即使两个请求的LORA被装入,一个符号不可知适配器在各地都应用两种身份,FLUQQQ联合关注让每个图像符号都读懂两个对象的文本符号. 一个主体消失,两个导火线变成一个混合体,或者模型逃出一个分屏拼接. 自动加载两个LORAs将两个主体保留在1.7%的被搁置图像中,低于26.7%的只知道类词的基准模型的26.7+;多主体个性化的压力测试报告同样的崩溃[8].

blocks.en: Two lines of work address halves of the problem. Merging methods fold many adapters into one weight [ 17 , 46 , 48 , 19 , 43 , 38 ] ; the data-aware ones, RegMean [ 19 ] and its LoRA-subspace form SSR-Merge [ 43 ] , keep each LoRA’s response on its own inputs and remove most pool crosstalk. But a merged weight is static: it applies to all tokens alike and cannot bind an identity to a location, so merges compose no better than the base model ( bothC 0.08 0.08 – 0.23 0.23 vs. 0.27 0.27 at K = 10 K{=}10 , Tab. 1 ). Spatial composition methods route each LoRA to its region with masks: Regional Prompting [ 4 ] with user layouts, FreeFuse [ 24 ] and LoRAShop [ 10 ] with masks inferred from the base model. They assume only the prompt’s LoRAs are loaded, apply hard or blended masks, and still lose a subject in about half or more of the images at K = 10 K{=}10 ( Tab. 1 ). Moreover, routing the raw LoRAs is worse than routing a merged adapter ( bothC 0.59 0.59 vs. 0.94 0.94 , Tab. 2 ): routing does not remove the need for a good merge.
blocks.zh: 有两条工作线处理一半的问题。 合并方法将许多适配器折叠成一个重量[17,46,48,19,43,38];数据感知器,RegMean[19]及其LORA-subspace形成SSR-Morge[43],将每个LORA的响应保留在自己的输入上,并去掉大多数集合对讲. 但合并重量是静态的:它适用于所有符号,不能将一个身份绑定在一个位置上,所以合并的构成并不比基准模型(C0.08 0.08– 0.23 0.23 vs. 0.27 at K = 10 K{=}10, Tab. 1)更好. 空间组成方法将每个LORA带口罩带到它所在的区域:带有用户布局的区域促动[4],FreeFuse[24]和LORASHP[10] 带有底模型推断出来的口罩. 他们假设只装入、使用硬口罩或混合口罩, 此外,原LORAs的路由比一个合并的适配器的路由更糟糕(C 0.59 0.59对0.94 0.94, Tab. 2 ):路由并不能消除良好的合并的需要.

blocks.en: We combine the two in MORE, a training-free pipeline that merges once and routes early ( Fig. 2 ). Stage 1 merges the whole pool into one fixed-rank adapter with the SSR-Merge router, regularized and calibrated so that it holds at K = 20 K{=}20 , and factors it exactly into a shared part and one part per subject. Stage 2 reweights these parts per token, but only during the first 30 % 30\% of the denoising steps, when FLUX commits layout and identity; afterwards the static merge renders details. A soft text–region attention bias, without hard masks, binds each region to its subject’s tokens, and a cyclic swap guidance contrasts the prediction with one whose subjects are bound to permuted regions, which pushes the regions’ features apart instead of letting them homogenize ( Fig. 4 ). Our contributions are: • A routable pool merge: the SSR-Merge router with relative ridge, fixed rank and a padding-aware calibration, and an exact factorization of the merged adapter into shared and per-subject parts, so that one rank- 8 8 / 16 16 adapter serves all K K subjects ( Sec. 3.2 ). • Spatio-temporal decoupled routing for MMDiTs: early layout gating of the merged parts, a decaying soft text–region bias, and cyclic swap guidance, a structured instance of degraded-condition guidance that extends to any number of subjects with one extra pass ( Secs. 3.3 and 3.4 ). • A controlled evaluation with held-out seeds, paired bootstrap errors and a collage-aware coexistence metric, against FreeFuse, LoRAShop, Regional Prompting and LoRA Switch/Composite, with ablations of every component and tests on other layouts and on three subjects ( Sec. 4 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Weight-space merging combines independently trained deltas without data [ 17 , 46 , 48 , 12 , 26 ] or with activation statistics [ 27 , 19 , 30 ] . For LoRAs, merges operate in the adapters’ low-rank subspace [ 41 , 33 , 37 ] ; SSR-Merge [ 43 ] solves the RegMean objective restricted to the span of the stacked LoRA factors, and Pico [ 42 ] and SVC [ 23 ] damp output directions over-accumulated by many tasks. LoRASpace [ 38 ] is the closest parallel to our pipeline: it computes a pool-wide subspace once and reuses it in a static mode and an input-dependent routing mode. Its routing selects adapters per input, whereas we route the parts of one data-aware merge per token and step to bind identities to regions. Our Stage 1 adopts the SSR-Merge router unchanged; we do not claim a new merge rule, only the regularization, rank and calibration choices that make it hold for K = 20 K{=}20 subjects, and an exact factorization that makes it routable. Diffusion-specific concept fusion [ 13 , 39 , 32 , 34 , 40 ] typically retrains or constrains the LoRAs, which a user with an existing pool cannot do.
blocks.zh: 重量-空间合并结合了独立培训的三角洲,没有数据[17、46、48、12、26]或激活统计[27、19、30]。 对LORAs来说,合并在适配器的低级子空间运行[41,33,37];SSR-Merge [43]解决了限于堆叠的LORA因子跨度的RegMean目标,Pico [42]和SVC [23]潮湿输出方向被许多任务过度累积. LoRASpace [38] 是我们输油管最接近的平行:它计算出一个全池的子空间一次,并在静态模式和依赖输入的路由模式下再利用. 它的路由会选择每个输入的适配器,而我们则将一个数据感知合并的每个符号的部分进行路由,并步入将身份绑定在区域. 我们的第一阶段采用SSR-Morge路由器,没有改变;我们并不要求新的合并规则,只有正规化、等级和校准选择,才能使K=20个KQQ20科目得到控制,以及精确的因子化,使它可以运行。 扩散特异性概念聚变[13,39,32,34,40] 典型的复录或约束LORAs,拥有现有集合的用户无法做到这一点.

blocks.en: Training-free layout control in MMDiTs edits joint attention: Regional Prompting FLUX (RP-FLUX) [ 4 ] masks text–image and image–image attention per region with − ∞ -\infty entries for the first steps, and related works bind instances by bounded, layered or hard-bound attention or by latent transplantation [ 9 , 50 , 2 , 6 , 7 , 22 ] . TACA [ 25 ] re-weights cross-modal attention globally with a timestep-dependent temperature; our bias is instead local (each region only towards its own subject’s tokens), symmetric and decaying, and adds no hard blocking. For LoRA composition, LoRA Switch and Composite [ 49 ] alternate or average per-LoRA predictions, CLoRA [ 28 ] , OMG [ 21 ] and LoRA-Composer [ 47 ] use attention maps or segmenters on UNets, and the FLUX-native FreeFuse [ 24 ] and LoRAShop [ 10 ] infer subject masks from the base model’s early attention and route or blend the LoRA outputs. LoRAtorio [ 11 ] weights LoRA outputs per latent patch by their agreement with the base model and supports dynamic selection from a pool; it is the most relevant comparison we could not run. All these methods load only the prompt’s LoRAs; we keep the whole pool in one adapter and show that routing a merge beats routing the raw LoRAs. Classifier-free guidance [ 15 ] extrapolates away from an unconditional prediction; later work replaces it by a degraded model or condition: perturbed self-attention [ 1 ] , a weaker model [ 20 ] , semantically degraded conditions [ 14 ] , or normalized attention-space negatives [ 5 ] . Our swap guidance is a structured instance: the degraded condition keeps prompt, adapter and attention budget and only binds each subject to a wrong region. Multi-subject identity mixing has been measured by detector-based success and collapse rates [ 8 ] and by identity-decoupling metrics [ 18 ] ; our bothC follows the former and adds a collage check.

blocks.en: The two failure modes of Sec. 1 have different remedies. Pool crosstalk is a property of the weights: keeping all K K LoRAs available as one adapter requires each subject’s delta to survive on its own inputs despite the K − 1 K{-}1 others, which is what data-aware merging optimizes. Coexistence collapse is a property of token routing: a weight shared by all tokens, merged or not, gives every image token both identities, so it cannot be fixed in weight space. We therefore merge once, offline, and route the merged parts per token at inference.
blocks.zh: 第1节的两个失败模式有不同的补救方法. Pool crossalk是权重的属性: 保持所有 K K LoRAs 作为适配器, 需要每个主体的三角洲依靠自己的投入生存, 尽管 K− 1 K{} 1 其它的, 这就是数据意识的集成优化。 共存崩溃是符号路由的属性: 由所有符号共享的重量, 合并与否, 赋予每个图像符号两种身份, 所以不能固定在重量空间中 。 因此,我们合并一次,离线, 并引导合并的部分 每一个符号推论。

blocks.en: Equation 4 has the form of classifier-free guidance [ 15 ] with a degraded condition [ 14 , 20 , 1 ] : the negative keeps the prompt, the adapter and the attention budget, and only binds each subject to a wrong region. In the idealized reading of guidance as sampling from p ⁡ ( x | Ω ) ​ [ p ⁡ ( x | Ω ) / p ⁡ ( x | Ω π ) ] w p(x\,|\,\Omega)\,[p(x\,|\,\Omega)/p(x\,|\,\Omega^{\pi})]^{w} , the tilt rewards images by how much more likely they are under the correct binding than under the permuted one. An image whose regions show the same content, such as a hybrid or two copies, is nearly invariant under the permutation, so its log ratio is close to zero and it gains nothing; an image in which each region shows its own, distinct subject gains w ​ log ⁡ [ p ⁡ ( x | Ω ) / p ⁡ ( x | Ω π ) ] > 0 w\log[p(x|\Omega)/p(x|\Omega^{\pi})]>0 . Locally, everything the two conditions share, namely the scene, the lighting, W 0 W_{0} and the common trigger features, cancels in v − v π v-v^{\pi} , so the update acts only on features that discriminate a region’s subject from its neighbor’s. The cyclic shift is a derangement for every m ≥ 2 m\geq 2 , so one extra pass per guided step gives every region a negative, whatever the number of subjects; for m = 2 m{=}2 it is a swap. Swapping only the bias, not the LoRA gating, keeps the negative pass close to the positive one, so the difference isolates the binding. The cost is five extra transformer calls ( 28 → 33 28\to 33 ).

blocks.en: All baselines receive only the prompt’s two LoRAs, which is easier than our setting, where all K K are loaded. LoRA sum adds both at weight 1. LoRA Switch and Composite [ 49 ] are re-implemented on FLUX (switching every 5 steps; mean of per-LoRA predictions). RP-FLUX [ 4 ] runs the official code with our oracle layout, regional prompts “a sks ⟨ \langle class ⟩ \rangle ” plus the scene, − ∞ -\infty masks for 10 steps and base ratio 0.3; we report LoRA weight 0.5, since weight 1 collapses ( bothC .050 / .042, col .41). LoRAShop [ 10 ] and FreeFuse [ 24 ] run their official code and infer subject masks from the base model. SSR-Merge [ 43 ] is our reproduction of the published merge (one prompt per subject, λ = 10 − 4 \lambda{=}10^{-4} ) over the whole pool. For a comparison without a layout prior we also run MORE, auto layout : subject maps from a 5-step base-model pass (double block 18) are thresholded into two regions, as FreeFuse and LoRAShop do. blocks.en: The pipeline needs a layout; with automatic masks bothC drops by 0.24 0.24 . Small regions are its weak spot: in the big-small layout both subjects land in their boxes in only 11.7 % 11.7\% of the images ( bothC .475 .475 ), presumably because a small region collects too little attention mass. The bias also raises color saturation (by 0.08 0.08 on average at p 0 = 2 p_{0}{=}2 , with unchanged luminance), routing adds 2.4 2.4 s per image over the static merge, and prompts are shared between our dev and test seeds; and identity rather than coexistence remains the bottleneck at K = 20 K{=}20 ( minC .245 .245 ). Swap guidance separates region features, not crop-level identity similarity. All baselines receive the prompt’s own LoRAs, and LoRAtorio [ 11 ] is missing; our pool shares one trigger word, and the user study has a single rater who knows the method (though not the sides), so a crowd study ( ≥ 30 {\geq}30 raters) is needed before preference claims.

blocks.en: Composing subjects from a large LoRA pool fails on FLUX for two separable reasons, crosstalk among the pool’s deltas and coexistence collapse of a token-agnostic adapter. blocks.en: Appendix E Identity confusion
blocks.zh: 附录E 身份混淆

blocks.en: Table 7 reports a slot-confusion analysis in the spirit of MuDI [ 18 ] : for each detected crop k k we compute DINOv2 similarity to the references of every prompt subject j j ; “own” is the mean diagonal, “cross” the mean off-diagonal, “conf” the fraction of crops closer to another prompt subject than to their own, and “crop–crop” the cosine between the two crops. Our crops have the highest own and cross similarity and the highest confusion. This is partly a confound: when a baseline drops a subject, the second crop is a wrong object or background, which lowers cross similarity and confusion; and our two crops are often similar plush or toy objects under identical lighting. It nevertheless shows that our pipeline does not remove identity leakage between the two regions, and that swap guidance, which lowers feature similarity ( Fig. 4 ), does not lower crop similarity.
blocks.zh: 表7按照MuDI[18]的精神报告了一个插槽汇合分析:对于每个检测到的作物kk我们计算DINov2与每个即时标的jj的参考物相似; " 拥有 " 是平均对角、 " 跨越 " 平均离对角、 " 相信 " 作物的分量更接近于另一个即时标的,而 " 作物-作物 " 是两种作物之间的余弦。 我们的作物拥有最高的自身和交叉的相似性和最高的混乱. 这在一定程度上是一个困惑:当一个基线抛出一个对象时,第二个作物是错的物体或背景,这降低了相似性和混淆性;我们的两个作物在相同的照明下往往是相似的外加或玩具物体. 然而,这表明我们的管道并没有消除两个区域之间的身份渗漏,降低相似性(图4)的互换指导不会降低作物相似性。
